# Bundled AutoHotkey runtime

MouseHold bundles the official 64-bit AutoHotkey v2 runtime for its engine.

- Version: 2.0.31
- Upstream archive: `AutoHotkey_2.0.31.zip`
- SHA-256: `CA1A595ACA4528755D8D4CD7FED23D497A37BD9A0B6892072612D68DEE1BD00A`
- Upstream license: `license.txt` in this directory
- Release source: <https://github.com/AutoHotkey/AutoHotkey/releases/tag/v2.0.31>

The downloaded archive and non-runtime files are intentionally ignored by Git. The release bundle includes `AutoHotkey64.exe` and `license.txt` as Tauri resources.
